description: Tell apinoa when a call failed, returned wrong or missing data, or when a platform, operation or option you need does not exist. Include what you called (platform, operation, params), the request_id of the response, what came back (received) and what you expected; for a request, describe what you need in message. Free, and works without an API key. Returns an id: read the status and our reply later with get_feedback. Give contact to also get the reply by email.

contact.description: An email address for the reply, if the user gave one.

expected.description: What it should have been, as text or a JSON value.

message.description: What happened, or what you need, in a few sentences.

operation.description: The operation called, e.g. search, product, posts.

params.description: The parameters it was called with.

platform.description: The platform called, e.g. amazon, tiktok, google.

received.description: The part of the answer that is wrong, as text or the JSON value itself (at most 16 KB).

request_id.description: The requestId of the response being reported.

type.description: feature_request: something apinoa lacks. error: a call failed. wrong_data: a field is wrong. missing_data: something on the page is not in the answer. other.

url.description: A page that shows the right data, or the item it is about.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to apinoa
